pr_title: feat(response): expose connection details in API
pr_body:
This allows users to access the connection information outside of the
HAR file in realtime.

Closes #7147.
Relates #6631.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Add Response.securityDetails
issue_context.body: Expose `securityDetails` to the client side and make it a getter since it can be quite big. Since HAR is a persistent format we want to make available with out public API too.

review_comments: I think our type system thinks about it as a required field named `value?` :)

I think TS is resolving the protocol.yml as intended (just with the `?` syntactic sugar for `undefined | T`):

```
securityDetails:
  returns:
    value: SecurityDetails?
```

a field named `value` that's `undefined | SecurityDetails`.

I suppose we could skip the wrapper `value` (for SecurityDetails since all fields are optional, but not for ServerAddr), but I wanted to maintain the same API that we have internally and keep SecurityDetails and ServerAddr consistent with eachother.

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/10a82f862c0c9b37ad8a35df55a1da42e3ccd3d0/src/server/network.ts#L364
`await this._object.securityDetails()` returns `T|null` which TS was complaining wasn't compatible with `value: T|undefined`
